frames.pose: confident forward follow-through, stable stance, tool or fist directed right, not a victory dance

prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. ONE combat key pose, only one woman, transparent portrait canvas. Approved small-head SD reference is absolute anatomical and design authority: identical head size relative to body, same torso and limbs, shoulder width, hair, adult feminine face, black/red uniform. Keep original broad DOUBLE-BLADED axe shape, only one axe and exactly TWO arms and TWO hands with connected wrists and correct thumbs. Pose: confident forward follow-through, stable stance, tool or fist directed right, not a victory dance. Face screen right in shallow three-quarter view. Draw entire character AND ENTIRE axe in an invisible single-cell virtual grid. At least TWENTY percent completely empty transparent margin at all four outer edges. Zoom out enough to fit even the very highest axe tip; absolutely no part may touch or be cut by any image boundary. No grids, guides, labels, other people, shadows or scenery. No duplicate limbs, no extra hands. Preserve approved reference body proportions instead of making a bigger head. Use highest native available portrait resolution, target2048x2736. Keep effects minimal and contained.
